g.text: Nearby — Deployment Diagram with Trust Boundaries
Our infrastructure (managed host, one private network)
Z5 · External services — outside our control
so more instances go behind the same
CMP-02 and CMP-03 never call each other:
they meet only in the database.
Dashed frames are trust zones Z0-Z5;
TB5, TB6 our infrastructure ↔ external services
Each app host reads only its own env file;
local file reads cross no trust boundary.
